About the Bicycle World Tuesday No-Drop Ride group ride

A Tuesday evening no-drop ride from the Corpus Christi shop lot. Bring a working bike, water and a helmet. Rides are weather dependent, so confirm with the shop.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
